title: Product formula on one injective Lipschitz piece
statement:
Let P, m ∈ ℕ, K ∈ ℝ≥0, G : ℝ^m → ℝ^P with LipschitzWith K G, and B ⊆ ℝ^m Borel such that G is injective on B and differentiable at every point of B. Write Φ(s, x) := (s, x_1, …, x_P) ∈ ℝ^{P+1} for s ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^P (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ x))) and π(y) := (y_1, …, y_P) (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y))), with H^k := μHE[k]. Then for every Borel g : ℝ^{P+1} → [0, ∞]:
(1) φ(s) := ∫⁻_{G(B)} g(Φ(s, x)) dH^m(x) is a measurable function of s ∈ ℝ;
(2) ∫⁻_{{y : π(y) ∈ G(B)}} g dH^{m+1} = ∫⁻_ℝ φ(s) ds.
This is the product formula H^{m+1}⌞(ℝ × G(B)) = L¹ ⊗ H^m⌞G(B) for one injective Lipschitz piece.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (G : Eucl m → Eucl P) (K : ℝ≥0) (B : Set (Eucl m)), LipschitzWith K G → MeasurableSet B → InjOn G B → (∀ b ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ G b) → ∀ g : Eucl (P + 1) → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → Measurable (fun s : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in G '' B, g ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ x))) ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) ∧ ∫⁻ y in {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ G '' B}, g y ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))) = ∫⁻ s : ℝ, ∫⁻ x in G '' B, g ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ x))) ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))
